name: SNAFU Con
blurb: An anime convention at the Reno-Sparks Convention Center with eleven Guests of Honor spanning voice acting, comics and cosplay.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'Friday, October 9th through Sunday, October 11th, 2026 in The Reno-Sparks Convention Center, 4590 S Virginia St, Reno, NV 89502'.

notes: Bios on the Guests of Honor page are cut off at 240 characters by the extractor, so categories/known-for use as much of each bio as was visible. Kenny Loui's bio calls him a graphic novelist, scriptwriter and voice actor (ending mid-sentence on a voice-acting award nomination), and Shane Tay's card says 'actor' but places him at Ascendent Animation, the same anime-dub studio named in Christopher Escalante's and Kay Kennedy's clearly voice-acting bios -- both are filed under 'voice' on that basis.
